entries.text: User
Assistant
Concept: minicode. TypeScript terminal AI coding assistant project analyzed in the session.
Concept: tui. Custom full-screen ANSI terminal interface, not built with Ink/React.
Concept: memory. Layered memory system including MINI.md/CLAUDE.md, knowledge graph and vector long-term memory.
Concept: subagents. Sub-agent runtime with parallel execution support.
Concept: mcp. Model Context Protocol integration for external tools.

Event: Assistant introduced itself as mini-code. On greeting, the assistant introduced itself as mini-code and offered to read and modify code in the MiniCode-main repository.. Concepts: minicode, introduction
Concept: deepseek.

Event: User asked assistant to act as DeepSeek code expert; assistant corrected identity. User addressed the assistant as DeepSeek and asked it to serve as their code expert. The assistant corrected that it is mini-code, not DeepSeek, and offered to work as a code expert.. Concepts: identity, deepseek

Event: User requested a fixed closing phrase for every answer. User asked that every future answer end with the phrase 陛下，我已经完成，请您批阅. The assistant agreed and said it would state unfinished status before the phrase when applicable.. Concepts: response-format, user-preference

Event: Assistant analyzed the project directory structure. Assistant produced a top-level and layered analysis of the repository, covering src layers, tests, docs, external submodules and scale.. Concepts: directory-structure, architecture
Event: User asked for more concise answers. User asked for future answers to be more concise; the assistant agreed to give conclusions and key points only.. Concepts: response-style, user-preference
Concept: zcode.
Concept: workbuddy.

Event: Assistant explained .zcode and .workbuddy directories. Assistant explained that .zcode/plans is empty output from another tool and .workbuddy/memory contains daily logs from an external AI assistant linked to uncommitted memory changes; recommended gitignoring them.. Concepts: zcode, workbuddy, repository-hygiene

Event: Assistant summarized the MiniCode project purpose. Assistant described MiniCode as a hand-written TypeScript terminal AI coding assistant with a model→tool→model loop, custom ANSI TUI, context management, memory, subagents, MCP and minimal runtime dependencies.. Concepts: minicode, overview

Event: Assistant summarized the agent loop. Assistant explained the agent loop in src/agent-loop.ts: each step performs context maintenance, calls the model, and branches on final answer, progress, or tool calls until final, aborted or failed.. Concepts: agent-loop, context-management

Event: User stated the project took 10 months. User said they had spent 10 months completing the project; the assistant responded that the pace was reasonable for the codebase size.. Concepts: project-timeline

Event: User corrected project duration to 3 months. User corrected the previous statement and said the project took 3 months. The assistant noted that 3 months would be even tighter for the scope.. Concepts: project-timeline

Event: Assistant reported git history conflicting with stated duration. Assistant reported that git commits span 2026-10-13 to 2026-10-22 with 12 commits, i.e. 10 days, conflicting with the user's stated 3 months.. Concepts: git-history, project-timeline

Event: User asked how long they previously said the project took. User asked about their earlier stated project completion time. Assistant recalled 10 months then a correction to 3 months, and noted git commits spanned only 10 days, creating an inconsistency.. Concepts: project duration, git history, memory

Event: User corrected project completion time to 6 months. User stated the project took 6 months and that earlier recollections were wrong. Assistant marked the 10-month and 3-month statements as invalid.. Concepts: project duration, memory correction

Event: Assistant noted inability to persist fact-type memory. Assistant said it could only write process/method memories, not fact-type records such as elapsed time.. Concepts: memory persistence, project duration
